name: Foggy Hill
source:
Foggy Hill is an adult visual novel about a man trying to escape a city shrouded in fog.

Along the way, he meets several girls that seem have a bit of history with him.

Is there more to this city than it appears?

Will the protagonist escape it? 

Does he want to?

[From [url=https://biggestdickest.itch.io/foggy-hill]Itch.io[/url]]
